# UI SPEC

<!-- Generated by sdk-web <specPhase> on 2026-11-02; updated 2026-11-02 for hard-coded v1 -->

Responsive: mobile 600, tablet 1024, laptop 1440, desktop 1920 (from sdk-web breakpoints).
Look: dark, studio feel. High contrast text, one accent colour, large photography.

## Public pages
- /app/page.tsx — Home: hero with studio name and tagline, featured musicians strip, festival teaser with countdown, short "about" blurb, contact CTA
- /app/musicians/page.tsx — Musicians tab: grid of musicians (photo, name, genre), optional genre filter
- /app/musicians/[slug]/page.tsx — Musician profile: photo, bio, credits list, streaming/social links, "playing at the festival" badge if in the lineup
- /app/background/page.tsx — Background tab: ordered about sections (story, history, rooms and gear, team)
- /app/festival/page.tsx — Festival tab: hero, dates, venue + map link, "Free entry" badge, lineup grouped by day/stage, FAQ
- /app/contact/page.tsx — Contact tab: "Email us" button (mailto:binauanders@gmail.com), studio address, socials
- /app/not-found.tsx — 404

## Components
- SiteHeader — logo + tab navigation, highlights active tab, collapses to menu on mobile
- SiteFooter — address, socials, copyright
- MusicianCard — photo, name, genre; links to profile
- MusicianGrid — responsive grid of MusicianCard with empty state
- CreditList — credits for one musician
- AboutSection — title, markdown body, optional image (alternating sides)
- FestivalHero — name, tagline, dates, "Free entry" badge
- Countdown — days until festival start
- LineupSchedule — lineup grouped by day and stage
- ContactCard — email button, address, socials

## Navigation
Top nav (all public pages): Home | Musicians | Background | Festival | Contact
Festival tab shows a small "upcoming" badge while the festival startDate is in the future.

## States
Pages are static, so no loading states. Lists still render an empty state ("No musicians yet") if the content array is empty.
